limitations: Public circuits are not identical; three medians are descriptive, not a tight confidence interval. Earlier incomplete attempts remain visible.
selection_requirements: All planned mandatory assertions must pass and every required metric must be measured.
Pass original-image 512 MiB comparison against both fresh paired medians and the frozen original-image median reference.
Pass 128 MiB comparison against the frozen previously accepted data-only control.
Complete image no larger than the previous qualified RAM iteration.
512 MiB idle/peak-process RSS within the unchanged 5% allowance of the old compressed image repeated under the same apparatus.
128 MiB bootstrap/onion/throughput and RSS/peak-process within existing 20%/5% limits of the freshly interleaved RAM control.
Preserve the full direct per-artifact comparison against RAM, even when only executable/root size growth rejects it; do not override that automatic status.
Select the smallest complete boot set satisfying these requirements; otherwise retain the qualified RAM image and explicitly report unresolved original-reference performance.
